lines.t: This was the first game ever to hit one billion downloads on Google Play.
Subway Surfers came out on May 24th, 2012, made by two Danish studios, Kiloo and SYBO.
You play Jake, a kid caught spraying graffiti on the train tracks. Then you run.
An inspector and his dog chase you, while you dodge trains, poles and barriers.
Swipe to jump, roll and switch lanes, and grab coins, jetpacks and super sneakers along the way.
Crash once, and the run is over, unless you spend a key to keep going.
Since 2013, the World Tour has moved the game to a new city every three weeks.

sc.sub: a new city every 3 weeks, since 2013

lines.t: In March 2018, it became the first game on Google Play to reach one billion downloads.
Two months later, it passed two billion.
It was the most downloaded mobile game every year from 2012 to 2019.
It even got its own animated series on YouTube in 2018.
And you've probably seen it under TikTok videos, where people play it to keep your attention.

sc.sub: the gameplay that holds your attention

lines.t: In February 2026, a brand new game arrived: Subway Surfers City.
